title: DATA↔DEVOPS-001: Data-Infrastructure Resource + Deployment Requirements
description: Data declares its infrastructure resource and deployment requirements; DevOps provides compute/storage backends, the Kubernetes platform, CI/CD, and the observability stack. Grounded in DATA_ENGINEER_SKILL §6.6 (DevOps/Platform Engineer).

component.description: Data pipeline component requiring infrastructure, e.g. 'kafka-connect', 'airflow', 'timescaledb'.

platform_dependencies.description: DevOps-provided platform capabilities the component depends on.

metrics_endpoint.description: Component exposes a metrics endpoint for scraping.

log_forwarding.description: Structured log forwarding to the observability stack.

scale_target.description: Reference scale this provisioning supports, e.g. '50,000-device fleet'.

x-macp.tier_rationale: Routine resource provisioning (agent-autonomous). A platform/orchestration change (e.g., new cluster, new object store) is a platform decision → Tier-1 ADR.
x-macp.cadence: TRIGGER (infrastructure alignment at planning; pipeline deployment during development); CONTINUOUS (shared monitoring/incident response)
confirm_conditions: compute and storage requirements are quantified with units
platform_dependencies reference capabilities DevOps actually provides
observability_hooks present (metrics + log forwarding) for production components
provisioning validated against the reference fleet scale
reject_conditions: resource request unbounded or missing units
dependency on a platform capability not in the supported set without an ADR
production component with no observability hooks
counter_conditions: requested capacity exceeds the current cluster budget — request capacity-planning review
retention_days conflicts with the security/compliance retention policy — request reconciliation with SEC
